blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former President Rodrigo Duterte’s camp says his alleged cognitive impairment has left him barely able to clarify matters that could help defend himself against charges before the International Criminal Court (ICC). The claim comes days before his scheduled trial opening on Nov. 30, although the ICC ruled in October that Duterte is fit to stand trial. Meanwhile, a low-pressure area (LPA) outside the Philippine Area of Responsibility is expected to bring scattered rains and thunderstorms to Palawan, while the shear line, northeast monsoon or Amihan, and easterlies are forecast to bring rain to other parts of the country.
